title: 人物关系与性格
html:
人物关系与性格

概述

本章围绕"人物"这一高频话题，按四个子场景组织词汇：家庭成员、社交关系、性格与特质、身份与角色。目标是让读者在介绍身边人、描述彼此关系、评价他人性格时都能找到准确的说法。每个子场景都配有听说例句与写作表达，兼顾口语对话与书面描述两种用法。学习时建议先记住词性、含义与常见搭配，再通过例句体会词在真实句中的位置与语气。

家庭成员

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
spouse n. 配偶 loving spouse, supportive spouse
sibling n. 兄弟姐妹 older/younger sibling, sibling rivalry
relative n. 亲戚 close/distant relative, visit relatives
guardian n. 监护人 legal guardian, appointed guardian
ancestor n. 祖先 common ancestor, trace ancestors
descendant n. 后代 direct descendant, future descendants

听说例句

A: Do you have any siblings? B: Yes, I have an older brother and a younger sister. We are pretty close.

A: Are you going to the family reunion this weekend? B: Definitely. Most of my relatives will be there, including some distant cousins I haven't seen in years.

写作表达

  • She is a direct descendant of a well-known historical figure.
  • The legal guardian is responsible for the child's welfare and education.

社交关系

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
acquaintance n. 熟人 casual acquaintance, mutual acquaintance
colleague n. 同事 close colleague, former colleague
companion n. 同伴 travel companion, constant companion
peer n. 同龄人/同辈 peer pressure, peer review
mentor n. 导师 find a mentor, serve as mentor
rival n. 对手 business rival, fierce rival

听说例句

A: How do you know Sarah? B: She's just an acquaintance from a conference. We've only met a couple of times.

A: Do you have a mentor at work? B: Yes, my manager has been a great mentor. He gives me honest feedback and career advice.

写作表达

  • Peer pressure can significantly influence decision-making among young professionals.
  • A trusted mentor provides both guidance and accountability throughout one's career.

性格与特质

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
outgoing adj. 外向的 outgoing personality, naturally outgoing
introverted adj. 内向的 introverted person, slightly introverted
ambitious adj. 有雄心的 ambitious goal, highly ambitious
reliable adj. 可靠的 reliable person, proven reliable
stubborn adj. 固执的 stubborn attitude, too stubborn
considerate adj. 体贴的 considerate gesture, very considerate
humble adj. 谦逊的 humble attitude, stay humble
resourceful adj. 足智多谋的 resourceful thinker, remarkably resourceful

听说例句

A: What's your new teammate like? B: She's really outgoing and ambitious. She always takes the initiative in meetings.

A: I heard Tom can be a bit stubborn. B: He is, but he's also incredibly reliable. Once he commits to something, he always delivers.

写作表达

  • A considerate leader takes into account the needs and feelings of every team member.
  • Resourceful individuals tend to thrive in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

身份与角色

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
newcomer n. 新人 welcome newcomers, industry newcomer
veteran n. 老手 industry veteran, seasoned veteran
volunteer n. 志愿者 volunteer work, recruit volunteers
representative n. 代表 sales representative, elected representative
candidate n. 候选人 qualified candidate, interview candidates
stakeholder n. 利益相关者 key stakeholder, stakeholder meeting

听说例句

A: Is she new to the company? B: Yes, she's a newcomer, but she's already making a strong impression.

A: Who will attend the stakeholder meeting tomorrow? B: All key stakeholders, including the product manager and the engineering lead.

写作表达

  • As a seasoned veteran in the industry, he brings over 20 years of hands-on experience.
  • All qualified candidates are encouraged to submit their applications before the deadline.
